daily_summary: 当日 vLLM 的变更主要集中在四条主线：(1) 模型层重构：Qwen2 迁移到 Transformers modeling backend，Qwen3 从继承 Qwen2 改为自包含实现，并移除已由 Transformers v5 不兼容的 OpenPangu-VL；同时升级 Transformers 至 5.23.0 并为多个多模态 processor 做兼容适配。(2) 多模态 device-side normalize 扩展：LLaVA-OneVision 与 Qwen3-Omni 支持 mm_device_do_normalize，Bee/RVL 显式 opt-out。(3) 性能优化与 kernel 修复：TRT-LLM FP8 MoE 允许 EPLB、B12X NVFP4 CSF scales 保持压缩、sparse NCCL weight transfer 分批传输、ROCm M3.1 GEMM 与 Minimax XCD 平衡、XPU DeepSeek-V4 qnorm/RoPE int64 修复，以及一次覆盖 526 个文件的 dataclass slots=True 大规模优化。(4) 修复 aux output routed-experts row cache 的容量来源不一致问题。整体上，上游模型/processor 与 dataclass 内存布局的变更较多，硬件平台特定 kernel 变更（ROCm/NVIDIA/XPU）与 vllm-ascend 无关。
ascend_impact_summary: 对 vllm-ascend 影响最大的变更包括：Qwen2 模型文件被删除且 ModelRegistry 将其迁至 Transformers backend，任何 ascend 代码引用 vllm.model_executor.models.qwen2 或依赖 Qwen2Model/Qwen2ForCausalLM 会直接 ImportError；OpenPangu-VL 与 MRotaryEmbeddingInterleaved 被删除，直接影响华为模型支持；dataclass slots=True 的大规模变更可能使 ascend 继承上游 dataclass 的子类出现 slot 冲突或 __dict__/vars 访问失败；AuxOutputSchedulerConnector 构造函数签名变更影响继承 Scheduler 的 AscendScheduler；多模态 mm_device_do_normalize 与 Transformers backend 的 EAGLE-3 aux hidden state 记录机制变更需要 ascend 在多模态与 spec decode 路径上验证。ROCm/NVIDIA B12X/XPU 特定 kernel 与 CI/build、依赖升级类变更对 ascend 无直接影响。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) Fix vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_qwen3vl.py::forward_with_split_qkv_rmsnorm_mrope: it must check self.qk_norm (or getattr(self, 'q_norm', None)) before using self.q_norm/self.k_norm. When qk_norm=False (all Qwen2-derived models now mapped to Qwen3), skip RMSNorm and do not call torch.ops.vllm.triton_split_qkv_rmsnorm_mrope; fall back to qkv.split + self.rotary_emb. Both the AscendMRotaryEmbedding branch and the else branch currently dereference q_norm/k_norm unconditionally and will raise AttributeError for Qwen2ForRewardModel/Qwen2ForProcessRewardModel (Qwen2.5-Math-RM), MiniCPM-V 2.6, Ovis, KimiAudio, FireRedASR2, DotsOCR and MiMo. Consider only rebinding Qwen3Attention.forward when q_norm exists, or dispatching on self.qk_norm inside the override. Qwen3MoeAttention is unaffected. 2) Decide the Ascend policy for top-level Qwen2: Qwen2ForCausalLM/Qwen2Model now resolve to TransformersForCausalLM/TransformersEmbeddingModel. Either register an Ascend-specific Qwen2ForCausalLM override in vllm_ascend/models/__init__.py to keep a native implementation (preserves fused linear/RMSNorm/custom ops, LoRA/quantization/sleep-mode/spec-decode behavior), or validate the Transformers backend path on NPU (patch_attn_utils already wraps vllm_attention_forward) and confirm custom ops, PP, LoRA, quantization and ACLGraph still work. 3) Update xlite for Qwen2: vllm_ascend/xlite/xlite.py::StandardXliteModel._build_model expects self_attn.qkv_proj / mlp.gate_up_proj; with the Transformers backend Qwen2 exposes HF q_proj/k_proj/v_proj and gate_proj/up_proj (and no qkv_proj), so either add HF weight mapping/concatenation for Qwen2 or reject/redirect Qwen2ForCausalLM in get_adapter_xlite_model. Update docs/source/user_guide/feature_guide/graph_mode.md and support_matrix accordingly. 4) Add regression coverage: build a Qwen2-style Qwen3Attention with qk_norm=False under the Ascend patch, and run the Qwen2.5-Math-RM reward and Qwen2.5 classification e2e tests to catch the missing q_norm and numerical mismatches.
deep_analysis.risk: High. The concrete runtime failure is an AttributeError/KeyError on self.q_norm/self.k_norm in the globally applied Qwen3Attention patch for every Qwen2-derived model now built from Qwen3Model with qk_norm=False (notably the documented Qwen2.5-Math-RM-72B reward model and Qwen2-based pooling/composite models). Separately, silently switching top-level Qwen2/Qwen2 embedding to the Transformers modeling backend drops Ascend custom-op/fused-kernel paths, so accuracy can stay correct while performance and feature support (LoRA/quantization/sleep/spec-decode) regress; xlite graph mode for Qwen2 also breaks because its fused qkv_proj/gate_up_proj weight assumptions no longer hold. Because Qwen2.5 is one of the most common Ascend test/serving models, the blast radius is broad.

commits.comment: 对仓库内几乎所有内部 dataclass 添加 slots=True（526 个文件），以降低 Python 对象内存开销并减少 __dict__ 动态属性带来的风险。除机械性添加 slots 外还包含若干配套修复：vllm/config/utils.py 的 replace() 从 dataclass_instance.__dict__ 改为遍历 dataclasses.fields(cls)，以兼容 slotted dataclass；vllm/logging_utils/dump_input.py 的 prepare_object_to_dump 用于遍历 fields 而非仅 __dict__，确保 slotted dataclass 字段仍被匿名化；vllm/model_executor/layers/dash_attention.py 用 fields(metadata) 构造 DASHAttentionMetadata，避免 vars(metadata) 在 slotted 父类上失败。该变更是全局性的内存布局变更，核心模块的 dataclass（SchedulerOutput 系列、ModelRunnerOutput/SamplerOutput、CommonAttentionMetadata、KV cache interface、forward context、config 等）均受影响。

ascend_impact.functionality: 大量上游 dataclass 增加 slots=True，包括 vllm/v1/core/sched/output.py 的 IterationDetails/KVConnectorBlockState/GrammarOutput、vllm/v1/outputs.py 的 SamplerOutput/ModelRunnerOutput/DraftTokenIds、vllm/v1/attention/backend.py 的 CommonAttentionMetadata、vllm/forward_context.py 的 BatchDescriptor/DPMetadata、vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py 的 KVCacheTensor/KVCacheGroup/KVCacheLayerConfig/ManagerConfig、vllm/v1/worker/utils.py 的 AttentionGroup 等。vllm-ascend 中若存在继承这些 dataclass 并新增字段的子类（尤其是 KV cache spec/manager、attention metadata、scheduler output、config），在 Python 中会触发 slot 冲突（TypeError: cannot inherit non-empty __slots__）或子类字段未被正确初始化；若 ascend 代码使用 vars(obj) 或 obj.__dict__ 访问上述对象会 AttributeError；对 dataclasses.replace 的兼容已由上游修复，但 ascend 自研的 replace/序列化工具需自行适配。此外 slotted dataclass 的 pickle/msgspec 行为可能变化。

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_model_runner.py::initialize_kv_cache (full copy of upstream GPUModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache; calls upstream.init_attn_backend without the new no_attn_metadata_layer_names kwarg)

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Mirror the upstream MRV2 prefill_context_kv_only behavior in the two Ascend copies that bypass upstream code. (1) In vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_model_runner.py::initialize_kv_cache, after computing draft_attn_layer_names, add no_attn_metadata_layer_names = draft_attn_layer_names when isinstance(self.speculator, upstream.DraftModelSpeculator) and self.speculator.speculative_config.prefill_context_kv_only (else empty set), and pass it to upstream.init_attn_backend(...). Guard with vllm_version_is since older pinned vLLM lanes lack the kwarg (use inspect.signature or the existing version gate). (2) In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/attn_utils.py, import/filter with vllm.v1.worker.utils.groups_with_metadata_builders (or 'if not group.metadata_builders: continue') in _get_parallel_config_for_attn_metadata, the batch_tq_slots dsa_builder scan, and the per-group loop of build_attn_metadata; also apply the same filter in vllm_ascend/worker/device_metadata.py::TargetDeviceMetadata.build. These two changes must land together because once the patched initializer skips draft metadata builders, the target runner's attn_groups will contain draft groups with empty metadata_builders that Ascend's own build_attn_metadata would otherwise assert on in AttentionGroup.get_metadata_builder. (3) Update vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/model_runner.py's direct init_attn_backend call for parity where the lane supports the kwarg. (4) Guard AscendDFlashSpeculator.build_draft_attn_metadatas/DFlashAclGraphManager so they skip draft metadata when self.context_kv_only (wants_full is already disabled, but the builders are empty). (5) Update Ascend unit-test stand-in groups (tests/ut/spec_decode/test_mla_dspark.py, test_dflash2_v2.py, test_device_metadata.py, etc.) to provide metadata_builders, and port the upstream test_no_attn_metadata_layers_keep_their_layout_without_builders coverage.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. The default path is unchanged because no_attn_metadata_layer_names defaults to an empty collection and groups_with_metadata_builders only drops groups with no builders, so non-prefill_context_kv_only deployments are unaffected. The risk is confined to DFlash + prefill_context_kv_only on MRV2: after mirroring the upstream kwarg, any remaining Ascend loop that calls AttentionGroup.get_metadata_builder on a builder-less draft group raises AssertionError (len(metadata_builders) > ubatch_id), and skipping the initializer change silently retains the old wasted draft-metadata builds. The change must also be version-gated across the supported vLLM lanes (0.33.0 vs main), since the new kwarg/helper only exists on newer vLLM. Ascend currently has no prefill_context_kv_only tests or docs, so coverage for this mode should be added with the adaptation.

commits.comment: 该 commit 重构 EPLB 以支持 target 与 draft 专家拓扑不同的场景（DeepSeek V4.1 DSpark draft 使用 dspark_n_routed_experts）。主要改动：EPLBConfig 新增 draft_num_redundant_experts；SpeculativeConfig 新增 draft_enable_eplb、resolved_draft_num_redundant_experts，并新增 _verify_draft_eplb_config/_apply_draft_eplb_override/apply_draft_eplb_overrides，apply_draft_overrides 末尾调用 draft EPLB override；ModelConfig 新增 verify_eplb_config/get_eplb_expert_counts 并在 verify_with_parallel_config 中调用；EplbState 删除 validate_ep_configuration/assert_confs_equal，add_model 不再要求 draft 与 target 拓扑一致，rearrange 中每个 model_state 独立取 num_replicas/num_groups，_allreduce_list 改为 flatten 拼接以支持不同 physical expert 数；dspark_draft_supports_eplb 迁移到 spec_decode/dspark/config.py 并加入 ROCm 判断，同时支持 deepseek_v41。DSpark 加载侧去掉 expert_mapping 命中后的 break，以便一个 checkpoint expert 映射到多个本地 physical replica 时全部加载。文档补充 multimodel EPLB 说明。潜在风险：EPLBConfig/SpeculativeConfig 新增字段与 hash factor（resolved_draft_num_redundant_experts）会影响配置哈希与编译缓存；EplbState 去掉拓扑一致性断言后，若外部仍假设 target/draft 拓扑相同可能产生隐性错误；DSpark 权重加载每映射都写入会放大拷贝但语义正确。

ascend_impact.functionality: EPLBConfig 新增 draft_num_redundant_experts 字段、SpeculativeConfig 新增 draft_enable_eplb/resolved_draft_num_redundant_experts 与 apply_draft_eplb_overrides 方法、ModelConfig.verify_with_parallel_config 新增 verify_eplb_config 调用、EplbState.add_model 去掉 assert_confs_equal 且 _allreduce_list 支持异构 tensor。vllm-ascend 通过 patch_model_config.py 修改 verify_with_parallel_config、patch_speculative_config.py 处理 SpeculativeConfig.hf_config_override、patch_parallel_config.py 处理 ParallelConfig，并拥有自己的 vllm_ascend/eplb adaptor，这些 patch/adaptor 需要与新字段和新校验逻辑保持同步；若 AscendScheduler/NPUModelRunner 走共享 EPLB 注册路径，draft EPLB override 语义也需对齐。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: Mirror the upstream DSpark EPLB changes in Ascend's model copies. In vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/dspark.py, remove the `break` after `loaded_params.add(name_mapped)` in the `.experts.` loop of DSparkDeepseekV4ForCausalLM.load_weights (this file already passes num_redundant_experts to get_expert_mapping). In vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v41/dspark.py: (1) change DeepseekV41DSparkModel.get_expert_mapping to accept `*, num_redundant_experts: int = 0` and pass it to fused_moe_make_expert_params_mapping instead of the hardcoded 0, using dspark_n_routed_experts (or the normalized n_routed_experts) for num_experts; (2) in DSparkDeepseekV41ForCausalLM.load_weights call get_expert_mapping(num_redundant_experts=self.num_redundant_experts) and remove the `break` after a successful load; (3) set self.num_moe_layers = len(self.moe_layers) in set_moe_parameters because Ascend's DeepseekV41MixtureOfExperts.extract_moe_parameters does not set it for the non-empty case while upstream now uses collect_moe_layers which does. Review vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/pcp_utils.build_dspark_draft_config and AscendDSparkSpeculator against the new draft_enable_eplb and resolved_draft_num_redundant_experts fields; keep the PCP-only EPLB disable, but preserve the upstream-resolved draft count when draft EPLB is enabled. Confirm AscendEPLBController.maybe_register_speculator still delegates to draft_model_supports_eplb (super already checks draft_enable_eplb) and that AscendEplbState.add_model/rearrange handle per-model num_physical_experts/num_expert_groups now that upstream removed validate_ep_configuration. Update the V41 DSpark stub in tests/ut/models/test_deepseek_v41_dspark.py (get_expert_mapping now takes the keyword), extend tests/ut/models/test_deepseek_v4_dspark_eplb.py and tests/ut/patch/worker/test_patch_dspark_eplb.py, and add a V4.1 multi-replica regression. Update Ascend EPLB docs (expert_parallelism_load_balancer.md / model_runner_v2_eplb.md) for draft_enable_eplb and draft_num_redundant_experts, noting V1 dynamic EPLB has no draft support.
deep_analysis.risk: High correctness risk if not adapted. This commit makes dspark_draft_supports_eplb return True for deepseek_v41 on non-ROCm platforms, so V4.1 DSpark draft EPLB becomes enabled by default on NPU. Ascend's V41 copy still builds the expert mapping with num_redundant_experts=0 and lacks num_moe_layers, so EPLB registration/load either fails or leaves redundant physical expert slots uninitialized, silently corrupting draft logits and acceptance. Ascend's V4 loader also still breaks after the first successful mapping, which is wrong whenever a checkpoint expert maps to more than one local physical replica (for example when Ascend's distributed initial-map patch is bypassed or the redundant count is large). Upstream removed the same-configuration guard in EplbState.add_model, so Ascend must verify AscendEplbState/communicator/policies truly handle different per-model expert and group counts; otherwise async rebalance/HIXL transfers can mismatch. The new ModelConfig.verify_eplb_config adds strict (num_experts + redundant) % ep_size checks that may reject existing Ascend EPLB configs with per-layer overrides or Ascend-computed counts. Config ordering also matters: verify that Ascend's _dspark_post_init normalization runs before _verify_draft_eplb_config/resolved-count computation so V4.1 draft counts are not taken from the target.

The changed page/stride semantics and draft-aware block sizing sit directly in Ascend's KV allocation path, where a mismatch silently corrupts KV cache contents (wrong kernel page stride, aliasing across blocks) rather than failing fast. deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The new upstream logic (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py:1944-1952) computes dummy_num_reqs = min(max(batch_desc.num_reqs or num_reqs, cdiv(batch_desc.num_tokens, max_model_len)), max_num_reqs) and calls InputBatch.make_dummy(dummy_num_reqs, batch_desc.num_tokens, ...). Because vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_input_batch.py:26-27 binds that symbol to AscendInputBatch, AscendInputBatch.make_dummy (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/input_batch.py:115-136) receives num_reqs > 1 while its dummy_num_tokens workaround (set by NPUModelRunner._preserve_dummy_query_tokens, vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py:1229-1247, to max(num_tokens, decode_query_len) under PIECEWISE) rewrites num_tokens down to the logical scheduled count. On an idle DP rank in PIECEWISE mode with DP-padded tokens > max_model_len, num_reqs (cdiv) > num_tokens (logical), so InputBatch.make_dummy trips `assert 0 < num_reqs <= num_tokens` (vllm/v1/worker/gpu/input_batch.py:143); the QueryLength invariant asserted by tests/ut/worker/test_v2_dummy_padding.py (query_start_loc_np[-1] == valid_tokens, seq_lens sum == logical tokens) can no longer hold. Adapt: (1) In AscendInputBatch.make_dummy, detect num_reqs > input_buffers.dummy_num_tokens and do not collapse the padded token count below num_reqs (e.g. keep the upstream split of num_tokens_after_padding across num_reqs, or set the layout token count to max(dummy_num_tokens, num_reqs)), while still preserving num_tokens_after_padding and the is_padding/zero-fill of the tail; do not simply clamp num_reqs back to the logical count, since that reintroduces the unbounded seq_len/block-table-row bug the upstream commit fixes. (2) Revisit NPUModelRunner._preserve_dummy_query_tokens so the DP-padding case is distinguishable from PIECEWISE capture-bucket padding (it currently only knows the logical _dummy_run num_tokens, not batch_desc/DP-padded tokens); a per-call hook that knows the dispatched batch_desc (e.g. wrapping execute_model like the existing gather_batch_req_state override) is the least fragile option. (3) Verify prepare_dummy_attn -> prepare_v41_dummy_ring_state (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/utils.py:241-259) with num_reqs up to max_num_reqs: it raises if num_reqs >= num_blocks and now zeros kv_cache[0][1:num_reqs+1] per idle step, so confirm num_blocks > max_num_reqs and that per-idle-step overhead is acceptable for DSv4.1 ring caches. (4) Verify get_dummy_block_tables/get_dummy_slot_mappings and the PCP path (_build_sharded_dummy_attention_context uses input_batch.num_reqs_after_padding) accept the larger request count, and that the 310P make_dummy wrappers in vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/aclgraph.py:94-111 and vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/spec_decode/aclgraph.py:118-132 still pass through correctly. (5) Add a unit test mirroring upstream test_idle_dp_dummy_batch_respects_max_model_len: AscendInputBatch.make_dummy(num_reqs=2/6, num_tokens=padded, input_buffers with dummy_num_tokens=1/2) must not assert and must keep every seq_len <= max_model_len; extend tests/ut/worker/test_v2_dummy_padding.py with the num_reqs > logical-tokens case.
deep_analysis.risk: medium. Without the change, idle DP ranks in PIECEWISE cudagraph mode (also used for pooling models and KV connectors such as AscendStore, which forces PIECEWISE) raise AssertionError at vllm/v1/worker/gpu/input_batch.py:143 as soon as a peer's DP-padded token count exceeds max_model_len, which is a legal SchedulerConfig (`max_num_batched_tokens > max_num_seqs * max_model_len` only warns). The fix is subtle: naively clamping num_reqs back to the logical token count preserves the old Ascend layout but silently reintroduces the out-of-range seq_len/block-table-row access this commit fixes, while naively keeping the padded split changes query_start_loc/seq_lens sums that Ascend's DP parity, DP idle wave-sync, and DSv4.1 ring-state zeroing rely on. Changes also touch the shared make_dummy path used by capture/profiling, so regressions could surface beyond DP idle. Validate specifically DP>1 + idle rank + PIECEWISE + large DP padding, plus capture/profiling dummy runs and the 310P wrappers.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: No hard breakage today: both Ascend architectures are re-registered (vllm_ascend/models/__init__.py lines 50-56) so _resolve_mm_device_do_normalize sees supports_mm_device_do_normalize=False and forces the feature off with a warning. The adaptation is to mirror upstream so the new default-on optimization actually applies on NPU (and to make enabling it safe). (1) vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/mm_preprocess.py: add the uint8 `_NORMALIZE_LUT` (torch.arange(256)/255-0.5)/0.5 -> bf16.view(int16).numpy(); add keyword-only do_rescale/do_normalize to load_image and DeepseekV4VLImageProcessor.__call__; when do_normalize is true index the LUT then .view(torch.bfloat16), else return torch.from_numpy(np.asarray(image, dtype=np.uint8)); assert do_rescale == do_normalize; change the patch reshape to x.permute(2,0,1).reshape(...). Thread the flags through DeepseekV4VLProcessor.__init__/__call__ and make DeepseekV4VLProcessingInfo.get_hf_processor construct the processor with do_rescale=do_normalize=not self.ctx.get_mm_config().mm_device_do_normalize. (2) vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/vision.py and vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v41/vision.py: import FusedMMInputNorm/IdentityInputNorm from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.mm_input_norm; in DeepseekV4PatchEmbed/DeepseekV41PatchEmbed add self.input_norm = IdentityInputNorm() and call x = self.input_norm(x.flatten(1), self.proj.weight.dtype) before proj; add enable_mm_device_normalize() on DeepseekV4ViT/DeepseekV41ViT that swaps in FusedMMInputNorm([0.5,0.5,0.5],[0.5,0.5,0.5],1/255) (upstream cannot use build_mm_input_norm because DeepSeek-V4 has no HF image-processor config). On NPU FusedMMInputNorm dispatches through forward_oot -> forward_native, so it is correct but unfused; optionally add an Ascend kernel later. (3) vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/vl_model.py and deepseek_v41/vl_model.py: add `supports_mm_device_do_normalize = True` on the wrapper classes, call self.vision.enable_mm_device_normalize() after vision/aligner .to(dtype) when self.multimodal_config.mm_device_do_normalize is set, and delete the `patches = patches.to(self.aligner.w1.weight.dtype)` pre-cast (lines 141 and 175) so uint8 reaches patch_embed.input_norm; ViT output is already bf16 for the aligner. (4) The upstream vl_cudagraph.py change (patch_dtype = self.vision.patch_embed.input_norm.input_dtype or dtype) is not currently reachable on Ascend because AscendDeepseekV41ForCausalLM does not implement SupportsEncoderCudaGraph/DeepseekV4VLEncoderCudaGraphMixin; if encoder ACL-graph support is added later, use input_norm.input_dtype for dummy/capture patches. (5) Tests: port upstream tests/models/multimodal/processing/test_deepseek_v4_vl.py::test_mm_device_do_normalize into the NPU unit tests (raw uint8 via FusedMMInputNorm vs CPU-normalized bf16 patches, rtol ~1.6e-2/atol 1e-5), plus flag-off assertions that the processor still returns bf16.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. Today the change is effectively inert on Ascend (the architectures are shadowed and the capability resolves to False), so failing to port it causes only a perf/parity gap, not a crash. The real hazard is a partial port: if supports_mm_device_do_normalize=True is added without the uint8 processor path and input_norm in the Ascend vision towers (or without removing the patches.to(dtype) casts), the processor emits raw uint8 pixels that get cast straight to bf16 with values 0..255 instead of ~[-1,1], producing silently wrong image embeddings. The V4.1 path is especially fragile because AscendDeepseekV41ForCausalLM consumes the upstream DeepseekV4VLProcessingInfo/Processor while owning a separate vision tower, so the processor and tower must be updated together. Also note FusedMMInputNorm has no Ascend fused kernel (forward_oot -> native PyTorch), and the V4 Ascend processor is a full fork that will drift from upstream unless the LUT/normalization math is kept bit-equivalent.

commits.comment: 本 commit 修复量化 Kimi-K2.6（KimiK25ForConditionalGeneration）的 q/k/v scale 无法加载的问题。两处关键改动：1) CompressedTensorsConfig.get_quant_method 的判断从 isinstance(layer, Attention) 扩展为 isinstance(layer, (Attention, MLAAttention))，这样 MLA 层也会得到 CompressedTensorsKVCacheMethod，其 KV cache 量化参数（q_scale/k_scale/v_scale）才会被创建；2) kimi_k25.py 新增 orig_to_new_suffix 映射，将 checkpoint 中 .self_attn.attn.{q,k,v}_scale 映射到 .self_attn.mla_attn.mla_attn.*，并在 load_weights 中先拦截 .self_attn 下的 scale 权重、走 quant_config.get_cache_scale_mapper() 合并映射后直接 weight_loader 加载，再交给 AutoWeightsLoader 处理其余权重，避免 AutoWeightsLoader 因未知参数而丢弃 scale。潜在风险：该映射仅对 self_attn 下的三个 scale 生效，若其它模型/命名变体使用不同后缀需额外扩展；对非 MLA 的 Attention 层仍保持原行为。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) In vllm_ascend/quantization/configs/compressed_tensors_config.py, mirror the upstream CompressedTensorsConfig change: add kv_cache_scheme to AscendCompressedTensorsConfig.__init__/from_config, and extend get_quant_method so Attention/MLAAttention (or AttentionLayerBase used by Ascend MLA wrappers) returns an Ascend KV-cache quant method. Reuse AscendKVCacheMethod/AscendAttentionScheme (or upstream CompressedTensorsKVCacheMethod only after verifying its PyTorch/CPU Parameter creation is valid on NPU) so q_scale/k_scale/v_scale Parameters are registered with the attn_head-aware shape (n_scales = layer.num_kv_heads) and TP-aware weight loaders. Without this, the new mapping in vllm.model_executor.models.kimi_k25.KimiK25ForConditionalGeneration.load_weights has no Ascend parameter to land on and the upstream fix is not inherited. 2) In AscendModelSlimConfig.get_cache_scale_mapper, verify Kimi-K2.6 scale keys still resolve to .self_attn.mla_attn.mla_attn.* and make the mapping idempotent under the new pre-pass (the negative lookbehind must exclude already-nested .mla_attn.mla_attn paths for q/k/v as it does for fa_q/fa_k/fa_v); preserve the existing fa_q/fa_k/fa_v and indexer mappings and avoid double application between the explicit scale pre-pass and AutoWeightsLoader. Add UT coverage in vllm-ascend quantization/model-loading tests for CT MLA q/k/v scale loading and for Kimi-K2.6 modelslim fa_* scale loading, then run the Kimi-K2.6 W4A8 SIT load/accuracy cases.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium. AscendCompressedTensorsConfig is a full fork of upstream compressed-tensors and currently has no KV-cache/attention quantization path at all, so adding one changes all CT-quantized MLA models (DeepSeek, Kimi), not only K2.6. If q/k/v scale Parameters are created without corresponding NPU kernel consumers, scales can be silently ignored or have wrong dtype/layout semantics. The mapper composition (base q_scale->attn.q_scale, model .self_attn.attn.* -> .self_attn.mla_attn.mla_attn.*, and modelslim fa_* regexes) can double-map or drop scales; failures typically surface as AutoWeightsLoader 'There is no module or parameter named ...' during model load. The existing modelslim Kimi-K2.6 fa_* path must be regression-tested because it is the currently deployed Ascend path.

commits.comment: 本 commit 把量化 kernel 选择中的 activation 量化回退显式化，并新增 VLLM_STRICT_QUANT_SCHEME 环境变量。主要结构：1) 在 quant_utils.py 新增 check_activation_quant_fallback()，区分“把请求的 activation 量化降级为别的（含无量化）”与“给未量化请求额外加量化”，前者在严格模式下返回拒绝原因、否则 warning_once；2) 在 linear kernel 家族（ScaledMM/Mxfp4/Mxfp6/Mxfp8/NvFp4 及 MMLinearKernel 基类）和 fused_moe 的 FusedMoEExperts 基类新增 executed_activation_key() 默认实现，各具体 kernel（Marlin/Humming/B12x/CPU FP8/XPU W8A16 等）重写以声明实际执行的 activation key；3) choose_scaled_mm_linear_kernel 与各 init_* linear kernel、FusedMoEExperts.is_supported_config 在候选校验阶段调用该检查，严格模式下跳过会降级的候选并继续按优先级寻找，找不到则 ValueError 并给出原因；4) mxfp4 oracle 的 _filter_by_activation 在严格模式过滤 BF16 回退候选，B12xExperts 用 executed_activation_key 判断 SWIGLUOAI_UNINTERLEAVE 限制，MarlinExpertsBase/TritonWNA16Experts/CPUExpertsFp8 的 _supports_quant_scheme 收紧为 activation_key is None；5) 新增文档说明默认回退行为与严格模式边界。潜在风险：默认虽只增加 warning，但 _supports_quant_scheme 收紧与 executed_activation_key 语义会影响显式 --moe-backend/--linear-backend 的选择结果；严格模式下可能启动失败，属预期但需文档充分；新增抽象/默认方法对 OOT kernel 为 additive，但若 OOT 专家类自行实现 _supports_quant_scheme 且依赖旧宽松语义需复核。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。新增的 FusedMoEExperts.executed_activation_key 是带默认实现的 static 方法，默认返回 activation_key，OOT 子类无需改动；VLLM_STRICT_QUANT_SCHEME 默认关闭，且变更集中在 CUDA/CPU/Humming/Marlin/B12x 的 linear kernel 与 MoE oracle 选择路径，vllm-ascend 使用自有 quantization 与 fused_moe 实现，不经过这些 kernel 的 dispatch。
